phrases.english: no idling: clean (Cato on a rainy day)

phrases.latin: munditiās volō fierī; ecferte hūc scōpās
phrases.english: I want the place cleaned; bring the brooms out here
phrases.source: Plaut. Stich. 2.2.22, as cited by Lewis & Short

sources: Lewis & Short: munditia

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. clean house, clean up, tidy up, broom: dustpan, garbage, trash, garbage can, waste basket. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 38, 39, 290, 292, 307, 320, 401, 404.
Cato, Livy and Petronius from the Latinitas loci collections; Plautus as cited by L&S (edition spelling ecferte kept).
